paper.title_en: A Template-Based Search for Large-Scale-Structure--Correlated Anisotropy in the Nanohertz Gravitational-Wave Background Using the Public NANOGrav 15-Year Data Set
paper.abstract_en: Recent PTA analyses reporting evidence for a nanohertz common-spectrum process motivate targeted tests of whether any anisotropic component of the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) is correlated with the nearby large-scale structure (LSS), as anticipated for an astrophysical background dominated by supermassive black hole binaries. We present the first Bayesian PTA likelihood analysis that embeds an externally observed, full-sky galaxy-survey LSS template directly as an overlap-reduction-function (ORF) component. Using the 2MASS Photometric Redshift (2MPZ) galaxy catalog, we construct low-multipole LSS--correlated ORF templates in two redshift slices ($0<z\le0.1$ and $0.1<z\le0.2$) and model PTA cross-correlations as $Γ_{ab}=Γ^{\rm HD}_{ab}+\sum_i ε_i\,Γ^{\rm LSS(i)}_{ab}$, where $ε_i$ quantifies the amplitude of an SGWB component whose angular correlations project onto the fixed 2MPZ LSS templates. Applying this framework to the NANOGrav 15-year dataset, we find no evidence for an LSS-correlated component: the inferred $ε_i$ values are consistent with zero in both single-bin and two-bin analyses (e.g., $ε_1=0.20^{+1.68}_{-1.66}$ and $ε_2=-0.11^{+2.04}_{-1.83}$; 68\% credible intervals), and Bayes factors favor the isotropic Hellings--Downs hypothesis ($\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_1,{\rm HD}}=0.40$, $\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_2,{\rm HD}}=0.43$, $\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_{1+2},{\rm HD}}=0.11$). We therefore place upper limits on any 2MPZ-traced, LSS-correlated contribution to the SGWB at $z<0.2$. More broadly, our framework provides a reproducible pathway for incorporating observed LSS information into PTA anisotropy searches and naturally motivates extensions to finer redshift tomography and next-generation PTA datasets.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在NANOGrav 15年数据中首次将外部星系巡天模板嵌入PTA似然分析，检验纳赫兹引力波背景与近邻大尺度结构的相关性，方法新颖且结果重要。
decision.title_zh: 利用公开的NANOGrav 15年数据集搜索与大规模结构相关的纳赫兹引力波背景各向异性：一种基于模板的方法
decision.abstract_zh: 近期PTA分析报告了纳赫兹共同谱过程的证据，这促使我们针对性地测试随机引力波背景（SGWB）的任何各向异性分量是否与近邻大尺度结构（LSS）相关，正如以超大质量黑洞双星为主导的天体物理背景所预期的那样。我们提出了第一个贝叶斯PTA似然分析，该分析将外部观测到的全天星系巡天LSS模板直接嵌入作为重叠减少函数（ORF）的一个分量。利用2MASS光度红移（2MPZ）星系目录，我们在两个红移切片（$0<z\le0.1$和$0.1<z\le0.2$）中构建了低多极LSS相关的ORF模板，并将PTA互相关建模为$Γ_{ab}=Γ^{\rm HD}_{ab}+\sum_i ε_i\,Γ^{\rm LSS(i)}_{ab}$，其中$ε_i$量化了其角相关性投影到固定2MPZ LSS模板上的SGWB分量的振幅。将此框架应用于NANOGrav 15年数据集，我们没有发现LSS相关分量的证据：在单箱和双箱分析中，推断的$ε_i$值均与零一致（例如，$ε_1=0.20^{+1.68}_{-1.66}$和$ε_2=-0.11^{+2.04}_{-1.83}$；68%可信区间），贝叶斯因子支持各向同性的Hellings--Downs假设（$\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_1,{\rm HD}}=0.40$，$\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_2,{\rm HD}}=0.43$，$\mathcal{B}_{{\rm HD+LSS}_{1+2},{\rm HD}}=0.11$）。因此，我们对$z<0.2$处任何由2MPZ追踪的、与LSS相关的SGWB贡献设置了上限。更广泛地说，我们的框架为将观测到的LSS信息纳入PTA各向异性搜索提供了一条可复现的途径，并自然地推动了向更精细红移层析成像和下一代PTA数据集的扩展。
